title: A vanished folder tab is reset by hand in the poll, copying set_chat_list_view but missing its end_drag
trigger: Drag a pinned chat in a folder's list while another device deletes that folder
effect: poll sets folders.tab = None and clears selection, but chat_list.pin.end_drag() (done by set_chat_list_view) is skipped, so the pinned drag carries on over the main list
fix: one function that moves the view, used by the poll too (take the borrow out of `live` first)

title: The remote-folder-deleted fallback in poll_live copies set_chat_list_view by hand and drops the pin-drag end
trigger: Drag a pinned chat row while the selected folder is deleted from another device.
effect: folders.tab and chat_list.selected are reset but chat_list.pin.end_drag() (done by set_chat_list_view, listed.rs:75) is not, so the drag stays armed on a list that changed under it.
fix: Call one reset (set_chat_list_view split so it takes the folder list, not &self.live) from both places

title: NotifyView::actions is derived (hovered && reply.is_none() && can_reply) but stored and kept in step by hand
trigger: Hover a toast, open Reply, move the pointer out and back.
effect: No bug today: set_hovered and open_reply each recompute or clear it; a third writer would desync it. Reply state also lives in Shown::stage (Replying) in the manager, fed by ReplyOpened.
fix: Compute the Reply button from hovered/reply in render; one ReplyState owner (Stage::Replying) instead of reply.is_some() beside it

title: MenuSync uses registry_read: Option<Instant> as a 'read yet' flag beside registry and read_at
trigger: Menu sync task's first pass and each re-read
effect: registry, registry_read and read_at must change together (set_registry); None means nothing read yet and the default Registry stands in for it
fix: enum RegistryRead{Never, Read{registry, at, writes, clients}}

title: Passcode box mode is open + view + error + three fields reset by hand
trigger: Open, navigate, close or Lock now from the Settings passcode box
effect: open_passcode, close_passcode and goto_passcode_view each reset a different subset of open, view, error and the old/new/confirm inputs; DialogSpec reads `open` while the view decides the title and form
fix: Option<PasscodeBox{view, error}> with the inputs reset on construction

title: system_unlock and system_unlock_key must change together, set by hand at five sites
trigger: Turn system unlock on/off, lock, unlock, Turn off passcode, lock-screen Log out
effect: system_unlock_key is Some only while system_unlock is on: set in lock_by_passcode, unlock_done and set_system_unlock, cleared in set_system_unlock, submit_remove_passcode and confirm_lock_logout_in
fix: enum SystemUnlock{Off, On{held_key: Option<MasterKey>}}

title: Lock flag is held twice: PasscodeUi::lock_state and the LockGate global
trigger: Lock or unlock
effect: set_locked writes PasscodeUi::lock_state and publishes LockGate{locked} in lock_layer; two copies kept in step by one writer (and a test-only force_locked that skips the global)
fix: Read the global only (or derive PasscodeUi's from it)

title: Toast stage names a 2.8 s timer whose Task is detached
trigger: Any QR box toast (Copied, expiring...)
effect: open.toast holds (toast, Instant) and a detached task compares the Instant at fire time; the timer is not held in the stage, so it cannot be cancelled with the box and one task per toast lives its full time
fix: QrToastStage::Showing{toast, _timer: Task<()>}

title: PanelMotion::Closing never settles, so a closed gifts panel keeps the whole gift list in the drawn set
trigger: Open the Gifts panel, then close it
effect: motion.shown() stays Some(Gifts) at rest, so qr_drawn_gifts keeps adding every listed gift and qr_prepare_gift_art keeps preparing stills and re-requesting missing stickers on each poll while the panel is closed
fix: Closing settles to Idle once its duration passed, or shown() reports None at rest

title: OpenQr::swap is a one-shot animation slot nothing clears
trigger: Toggle an emoji in the QR box
effect: swap stays Some after SWAP_MS until the next change or close; qr_prepare_art keeps making stills for its `previous` emoji and the pattern keeps counting them
fix: Fold into PanelMotion-like PatternMotion enum that settles to Idle

title: Poll box rows are parallel Vecs kept in step by hand: option_inputs, attach and quiz_correct_rows (indexes)
trigger: Add and remove option rows, mark correct answers, attach media
effect: add_poll_option_row pushes two Vecs, remove_poll_option_row removes from two and fixes the third with forget_correct_row (guarded by `index < attach.len()`); a writer that misses one shifts media or marks onto the wrong option
fix: `Vec<PollOptionRow { input, attach, correct: bool }>`

title: AwaitSticker / AwaitEmoji on a poll option slot are not tied to the media panel that serves them; closing the panel leaves the prompt
trigger: Poll box: choose Sticker or the smiley on an option, close the media panel with Esc or a click outside
effect: The option keeps showing 'Choose a sticker in the panel' with a Cancel button, and a later panel open (poll_emoji_field / route_poll_option_sticker only check media_panel.is_open()) routes the next pick into that option
fix: One `awaiting: Option<(slot id, Await)>` owned by the panel's stage, cleared by the panel's own close

title: Poll option file read is answered by matching OptionMediaSlot::Preparing(path) text, not the slot id or a request id
trigger: Pick the same file for two options, or re-pick the file after removing it while the first read runs
effect: finish_poll_option_file takes the first slot whose Preparing(path) equals the answer's path; a second read of the same path can land in the wrong slot or be dropped
fix: `Preparing { request: RequestId }` (or the OptionAttach::id) compared when the read answers

title: Poll box 'switch + value' pairs are a bool beside the value it enables, reset by hand: limit_duration/close and limit_by_country/country_codes
trigger: Turn Limit Duration or Limit by Country on, pick a value, turn it off and on
effect: limit_by_country=false clears country_codes and leaves the page by hand (line ~333); limit_duration=false keeps `close`; submit re-checks `limit_by_country && country_codes.is_empty()` to catch the invalid pair
fix: `Option<PollClose>` and `Option<Vec<String>>` (None = off)

title: WithdrawOutcome::Url / TooSmall is a one-shot slot drained only by a per-window upkeep gated on the Collect dialog's host window
trigger: Press Collect from a chat window or while the dialog's host entry has moved, close that window before the answer
effect: grams.withdraw_outcome stays set (the Fragment page never opens, no toast) until some window whose dialog_may_show_in(GramsWithdraw) runs the upkeep, which can be much later
fix: Make the outcome part of the GramWithdraw stage (Done(Url|TooSmall)) so the box that asked consumes it, or drop it with the box

title: Premium limit toast is a one-shot hub slot taken only by the window of the last press
trigger: A full saved-GIF or sticker list limit hit by an action that is not a press (a paste or a background update)
effect: hub.take_limit_toast() is only reached when windows.pressed_here(); the toast stays queued in the session, also across an account switch away and back, and shows at an unrelated later press
fix: Carry the asking window in the slot, and clear it with the account's Farewell

title: Selecting a gift resets a second machine by hand: gift_manage.flow (Upgrade/Resale {id}) and hub.gift_view.selected both name the gift
trigger: Open a gift, start Upgrade, go back and select another gift
effect: select_gift() clears GiftFlow with take_if on a different id and also confirm_convert(None); another path that selects a gift without select_gift keeps the old flow and hides the buttons
fix: One gift-panel value `GiftPanel { gift, flow }`

title: edit_exception / edit_exception_chat close the picker even when the edit was ignored
trigger: Add a user to an exception list while the rule is Loading or Failed (not Ready).
effect: mutate_privacy_detail returns silently without a Ready detail, but `if add { close_exception_picker() }` runs anyway, so the picker closes and nothing is saved or said.
fix: Close the picker from the save's own outcome (mutate returns whether it sent)

title: start_personal_photo matches the box under the file picker by mem::discriminant, not by the box
trigger: Press Set photo in Edit contact, and while the picker is open (non-modal portal) open Edit contact of another person.
effect: `under` and `now` are discriminants of ProfileDialog: any EditContact matches any other, so the confirm opens over a different box than the one that asked.
fix: Compare the box's owner key (user_id) or a request token held in the stage

title: A user's pending gallery has no end when its fetch is dropped without an answer
trigger: Click a user's avatar when the profile photos request is lost (connection reset).
effect: pump_profile_gallery ends a pending Chat gallery on chat_photo_request_ended but a User gallery only on ProfilePhotosFetch::Failed, so a dropped request leaves pending_profile_gallery set with no note until the user navigates; a late arrival then opens the viewer over whatever is still on screen.
fix: Carry the fetch's RequestId in PendingGallery and end it when that request leaves flight

title: open_profile_dialog and open_birthday_privacy replace a Saving box without forgetting its request
trigger: Edit contact, press Save (box waits), then click Set / Suggest photo in the same box, or in the Birthday box click 'Choose who can see your birthday' while Saving.
effect: dialogs.profile_dialog is overwritten (open_profile_dialog:43, open_birthday_privacy:164) while ProfileDialog::Saving or ContactSave::Saving holds a request: forget_profile_saving is skipped, the saved toast and a refusal are lost, and an EditContact answer stays in dialog_answers (bounded). The body of a Saving box still has live rows. Two stage mechanisms (ProfileDialog::Saving and ContactSave::Saving) do the same job.
fix: One saving stage for every profile box, and replacing a box goes through close_profile_dialog; disable the body while Saving

title: GradientEditor::hsl duplicates colors[selected] and is synced by hand
trigger: Edit a color by hex, then move a slider; select another swatch.
effect: hsl is written in editor_sync_controls and editor_slider_moved while colors/selected are written in four other places; if one path misses it the sliders and the swatch disagree.
fix: Derive hsl from colors[selected] when drawn, with the slider drag value as the only extra

title: PhotoSources keeps mode, camera stage, emoji editor, note and serial in step by hand; camera tasks are detached and matched by serial
trigger: Open the camera panel, lock the app; open the emoji editor, then lock.
effect: close_photo_source and close_cameras_for_lock each reset mode, camera, serial (and note/editor in one of them) by hand; CameraStage::Starting and Saving hold no task (start_camera / take_camera_photo spawn detach()ed tasks and compare photo_target + serial). The lock path leaves the emoji editor and note as they were.
fix: One PhotoSources stage enum (Closed/Emoji{..}/Camera(CameraStage)) with the task held in Starting/Saving and one close()

title: failed avatar encode returns the editor to Ready with player None and never calls start_video_editor_player (the tray/edit-box Err arm does)
trigger: open the video editor for a profile photo, press Done, let the ffmpeg encode fail
effect: editor is back but the looping preview is gone for good (only the still shows) and the cover/trim playhead no longer plays; docs/decisions says the avatar path refills the player but it does not
fix: one EditorStage transition (encode_failed) that reopens its player, or a shared failure helper used by all three encode callers

title: ProxyUi::notice is a one-shot slot that only fetch_proxy_list clears
trigger: Copy a proxy link ('copied' notice), then enable, delete or ping proxies on the same page without reopening it.
effect: The notice line stays under the list through unrelated actions and is overwritten by seven sites (mod.rs:399,441,444,468,499,600; proxy_row.rs:194); only fetch_proxy_list (opening the list) sets it None.
fix: A Toast/StatusNote with its own expiry, or a notice stage cleared on the next action

title: delete_proxy_entry flips use_system and persists prefs before the removal is sent
trigger: Delete the enabled proxy while the connection to TDLib is down (removeProxy fails to send).
effect: prefs.use_system = true and save_proxy_prefs run first; remove_proxy's Err is dropped by `let _`, so the saved preference no longer matches the proxy that is still enabled and no error shows.
fix: Set the fallback in the answer to the removal (keyed by its RequestId), or undo it when the send fails

title: The link box's stage (link_check) and the auto-switch rotation are reset by hand from UI code
trigger: Open a tg://proxy link, press Check, cancel, open another link; or change the auto-switch seconds while a rotation is running.
effect: link_check is set to Review/Warn from handle_proxy_link, close_proxy_link, reset_link_check, connect_link_proxy and check_link_proxy (UI), while the box value lives in ProxyUi::link and the answer is matched by Checking(request); set_proxy_auto_switch writes Rotation::Watching from the UI. A stage reset from outside its own transitions.
fix: Fold ProxyLinkBox and link_check into one stage owned in one place (Review/Warn/Checking{request}/Done), and let the rotation reset itself on a prefs change

title: ProxyUi::list_box bool is kept in step with pane_mode by a per-frame sync
trigger: Open Proxy settings from the sign-in screen, let the account reach Ready.
effect: list_box is a bool whose truth is `list_box && pane_mode()==Connecting`; sync_proxy_list_box clears it by hand each frame, and open_proxy_list sets it and opens the DialogKind separately.
fix: Derive the box from pane_mode (a PaneMode::Connecting overlay stage) or hold it in the sign-in screen's own state
